title_en: Visions of the Future (12/20): Dreams of Cities on the Moon
note_en: 不只是A，而是B means "not just A, but B": the speaker grants A and then shifts the weight to a bigger claim. In the next-to-last sentence, 目标已经不只是…进行短暂的登月飞行，而是要建设…月面永久基地 says the goal is "no longer just brief Moon landings, but building a permanent base." Note the contrast with 不是A，而是B ("not A but B"), which rejects A entirely; adding 只 keeps A true.
